google_cse.description: RECOMMENDED - the only source with a real chance of working: official API, not scraping. All 4 scraping sources below are confirmed/likely blocked as of 2026-09-07. To enable: get an API key at https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials (enable 'Custom Search API' on the project), create a search engine at https://programmablesearchengine.google.com/controlpanel/all set to search the whole web, copy its Search engine ID into cx below, then set enabled to true. Free tier is 100 queries/day; daily_limit here is already set under that.

rss_feeds.description: DISABLED 2026-09-07: Indeed discontinued their RSS feeds - every query returns 403/404/429. Confirmed by direct test, not worth retrying daily.

indeed.description: DISABLED 2026-09-07: direct scraping also confirmed 403 Forbidden on every query from this Pi's IP. Re-enable only if you add a proxy and are prepared to keep fixing selectors when Indeed's HTML changes.
